messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Increase in 5xx error rate observed affecting serving in west-us2 at 2026-03-15T14:00Z — auto-failover attempted and partially failed, paging oncall.
ryan_oncall: seeing it. spike started ~13:58Z. dashboards show error-rate -> 18% for p99 requests.
jen_eng: logs show RPC timeouts on the west-us2 egress proxy cluster, TLS handshakes failing intermittently.
ryan_oncall: I'm taking lead. escalating to SRE. tagging @mike_sre
mike_sre: on it. running quick health checks, focusing on proxy and net path. can someone check if recent deploy landed in west-us2?
leah_prod: no deploys flagged for west-us2 in last 6 hours on console.
ops-bot: Deploy pipeline: no successful deploys to west-us2 in last 6h.
alex_support: support queue getting a few customer reports from orgs with traffic pinned to west-us2. prepping status page & customer note draft.
ryan_oncall: initial mitigation: attempt transparent reroute of new session traffic away from west-us2 -> us-west1. Running command now: ```sh
curl -X POST "https://ops-api.internal/reconfig/reroute" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" -d '{"from_region":"west-us2","to_region":"us-west1","mode":"new-sessions"}'
```
jen_eng: I see the reroute job started but some connections remained sticky; we should add a shorter TTL on region affinity and trigger active draining for problematic instances.
mike_sre: agreed. I'll trigger drain on the affected node pool and bump affinity TTL to 30s. Command: ```sh
opsctl pool drain --region west-us2 --label problem=true
opsctl config set affinity.ttl 30 --scope region:west-us2
```
ryan_oncall: after reroute start, 5xxs dropped from 18% -> 6% in 8 mins. still seeing intermittent spikes ~3-4%. monitoring.
incident-bot: PAGE: next handoff scheduled in 25 minutes to jen_eng. severity label: Sev2.
leah_prod: drafting status page update — can someone approve the copy? I'll post once approved. Draft: ```Status: Degraded performance in west-us2. Impact: increased API errors and latency for requests routed to west-us2. Mitigation: traffic is being rerouted to nearby regions, and we are draining affected hosts. We will provide updates every 15 minutes.```
jen_eng: looks good. add: "Customers with pinned routing to west-us2 may experience errors; to avoid impact, consider rerouting or enabling regional failover."
leah_prod: updated. preparing customer notification template for impacted customers. Draft: ```Hi <customer>,
We detected elevated errors for requests served from our west-us2 region starting at ~14:00 UTC. We are actively rerouting new traffic to us-west1 and draining affected hosts. If your configuration pins traffic to west-us2, you may see intermittent failures; we recommend enabling regional failover or updating your route to a healthy region. We will share a follow-up with root cause and timeline once available.
- Redwood Inference Status Team
```
alex_support: I'll send to the enterprise accounts already reporting issues; leaving placeholder for customer-specific notes.
ryan_oncall: note for oncall: if auto-reroute doesn't drop errors below 1% within 30m, escalate to infra lead and consider full region failover.
incident-bot: ACTION -> Create status page incident: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-1776500000 (draft created by leah_prod)
jen_eng: I want to capture a short rollback plan if config change made it worse: ```1) revert affinity.ttl to previous value; 2) restore drained instances; 3) re-open traffic to west-us2 via canary at 10%```
mike_sre: running deeper network diagnostics now (traceroutes, tcpdump on proxy nodes). I'll paste key traces in a follow-up message.
ryan_oncall: handing off active pager to jen_eng in 20m — summary for handoff: Sev2; ongoing mitigation = new-session reroute to us-west1, draining target pool in west-us2, affinity TTL lowered, status page & customer notifications drafted. Remaining risk: sticky sessions and customers pinned to west-us2.
jen_eng: taking handoff. thanks. my immediate actions: continue drain, validate downstream caches/KV consistency, and finish network traces.
alex_support: sent targeted customer note to 3 affected enterprise accounts. copied leah_prod.
mike_sre: added tcpdump snippets to thread: ```tcpdump: west-us2 proxy -> [RST] during TLS handshake from 10.11.22.33:443, repeated pattern with external peer 52.145.99.12```
jen_eng: interesting — external peer IP belongs to our CDN partner edge. opening ticket with partner; pinging their oncall now.
ops-bot: Support ticket created with CDN partner: TKT-8912.
leah_prod: posting status page update now. content includes impacted region list: west-us2; mitigations: traffic reroute to us-west1; ETA: ongoing with updates every 15m. posting... :hourglass_flowing_sand:
incident-bot: STATUS PAGE UPDATED by leah_prod at 2026-03-15T14:22Z.
jen_eng: partner responded — they saw an intermittent BGP flap affecting a subset of prefixes into our west-us2 egress POP. partner is applying fixes; they estimate 30-45m to fully converge.
ryan_oncall: good find. keep partner comms in thread. Jen, can you coordinate a contingency to shift more traffic to us-west1 if partner ETA slips?
jen_eng: will prepare a scaled reroute plan to move 60%+ of steady-state traffic and a rollback plan if downstream load impacts us-west1.
mike_sre: monitoring shows error rate now stable ~1.2% after partner action started; latency slightly elevated.
leah_prod: drafting a brief public update for customers: "We are seeing degraded performance in west-us2 due to upstream network instability. We have routed most new traffic to healthy regions and the issue is being mitigated. We will update when full recovery is confirmed." Approving before publish?
alex_support: thumbs. publish now.
incident-bot: CUSTOMER NOTIFICATION SENT to affected orgs at 2026-03-15T14:40Z (template id: cn-1776500000).
jen_eng: taking final verification steps. If stable for next 30m, we'll reduce severity and shift to monitoring.
ryan_oncall: thanks team. handing over full ownership to jen_eng. leaving notes in runbook: incident start=1776500000, mitigation applied, partner ticket TKT-8912, status page link, sent customer notifications, next check 15m.
jen_eng: acknowledged. I will close the loop when we return to baseline and attach RCA link.
mike_sre: adding short-term postmortem stub to docs: "network partner prefix flap -> partial egress failure in west-us2; mitigations: reroute to us-west1, drain nodes, partner fix applied"
incident-bot: HANDOFF COMPLETE. oncall now: jen_eng.
jen_eng: marking incident as "Monitoring" at 2026-03-15T15:10Z. Will update to Resolved once metrics hold for 60 minutes.
leah_prod: posted an internal comms template to #general with instructions for support reps on what to tell customers (copy/paste ready).
alex_support: support teams notified and fielded a small number of follow-ups. most issues subsided after reroute.
jen_eng: metrics report: p99 error-rate west-us2 -> 0.4% after 45m, latency trending down. Preparing resolve update.
leah_prod: customer follow-up draft for resolved state: ```Hi <customer>,
Issue: Elevated errors for west-us2 due to upstream network prefix instability.
Resolution: Traffic rerouted and partner applied fix; we drained affected hosts and validated recovery. We will publish a full RCA when ready. Sorry for the disruption.
— Redwood Inference
```
jen_eng: posting resolve to status page now.```
